who.title: A company built to accelerate your business
paragraphs: Valadares Global Tech (VGT) is a technology company focused on businesses across Latin America. We don't build generic tools: we identify the market's leading platforms, become their authorized partners, and deploy them with real hands-on support so every client gets the maximum return on their investment.

We act as a bridge between global innovation and the specific needs of each organization. Our team combines expertise in digital marketing, strategic design, and technology to deliver an integrated offering that goes far beyond selling software.

partner.title: Authorized distributor and partner
partner.subtitle: We are certified strategic partners of the solutions we represent, not generic resellers. That translates into stronger implementations and vendor-backed support.

items.name: Veritempo

pillars.title: Design

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To democratize access to world-class technology for Latin American companies, supporting them at every stage of their digital transformation with proven solutions, certified teams, and measurable results.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: To be the go-to technology partner for Latin American companies looking to grow with the world's best tools, consolidating our presence across the region as a bridge between global innovation and the local market.
